adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now loops over each destination calendar and calls `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)` (packages/core/EventManager.ts). However, `Office365CalendarService.createEvent` still selects the calendar URL using only the first element of `event.destinationCalendar` (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` then `/me/calendars/${mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId}/events`) and ignores which credential/destination is being processed (packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts). This means when creating events for additional hosts/credentials, Office365 will still attempt to write to the first (main host) calendar ID, which can plausibly 404 or create the event in the wrong calendar. This mismatch is directly verifiable from the diff.
